governed.config: checkmake reads checkmake.ini in the folder it runs from: the project decides which rules apply and their limits, such as the required phony targets and the maximum body length

suppressions.description: none: the tool has no in-file suppression; rules are tuned in checkmake.ini

en.label: checkmake (Makefiles)
en.purpose: Checks Makefiles for mistakes: missing required phony targets such as all, clean and test, phony targets that are not declared, overly long target bodies and missing timestamps.
en.limitation: It checks the shape of the Makefile, not whether the commands work. It reads checkmake.ini from the folder it runs in, and only the Makefile named Makefile is checked.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image: no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: checkmake (Makefiles)
pt-BR.purpose: Verifica Makefiles: alvos phony obrigatórios ausentes, como all, clean e test, alvos phony não declarados, corpos de alvo longos demais e carimbos de tempo ausentes.
pt-BR.limitation: Verifica o formato do Makefile, não se os comandos funcionam. Lê o checkmake.ini da pasta em que roda, e só o arquivo chamado Makefile é verificado.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas: sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
